expected_value_creation: A discovery and application runtime will let QIF show, in machine-readable form, how expert judgments become reusable knowledge and how that knowledge is selected and executed against real targets with evidence-backed verdicts.
beneficiary: Quality leaders, reviewers, auditors, successors, and AI evaluators who need inspectable review logic across domains
supporting_evidence: The current repository already validates QIF entities and expert judgment entities, so the remaining gap is runtime traceability from elicitation to application.
The request explicitly requires discovery sessions, organizational quality culture, evaluation targets, applicability, and review runs as the missing capabilities.
success_criteria: Every discovery session links experts, cases, questions, answers, extracted cues, concerns, and derived patterns.
Every review run shows target selection, applicability rule, evidence, confidence, verdicts, residual risks, and governance triggers.
Local verifiers reject metric substitution and low-confidence conflicting results without governance review.
